decisions.reason: The formwork profile line is close to the core offer, has several models and its own page, and costs little to hold while prefab demand stays solid, so keeping the option open is still worthwhile even though the missing 2020-2021 observations add some uncertainty.
The automated distributor flow control is built into the firm's automation strategy and integrated systems, so its upside as part of growing factory automation justifies its low holding cost.
Shuttering magnets are a cheap, recurring accessory that complements the formwork business, and the lack of recent visibility is not strong enough evidence to abandon them.
The magnetic formwork strips have their own page and a multi-model line, which signals commitment, and they remain inexpensive to keep within the magnetic formwork portfolio.

This component overlaps with the other magnetic options and was only mentioned on the website, so after four years it is the likeliest to be consolidated, but its minimal holding cost and the lack of decisive negative results argue for keeping it a while longer.
